title: NUCLEAR "FISH-ON" - Play Test Live!
author: Known-Conversation62
selftext:
The goal is basically:

Go fishing → catch fish → make money → upgrade your gear → go somewhere even more radioactive.

It's currently a closed very early beta, and I'd really like some people to give it a proper play and tell me what sucks / what needs improving about the atmosphere etc.

Pro Tip: You end the night run at Rangers Landing to access the purification/upgrades.

👉 PLAY IT HERE:  
[https://nuclear-fish-on.nocodegamestudios.workers.dev/](https://nuclear-fish-on.nocodegamestudios.workers.dev/)

It's completely browser-based, no download required.

If you play it, I'd especially love to hear:

* What you think of the fishing
* Whether the progression feels fun
* Which fish you discover
* Anything that's confusing or annoying
* What you'd add to the game

feedback is genuinely useful. ☢️🎣

[](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/?f=flair_name%3A%22Commercial%20Self%20Promotion%22)

comments.author: UpDown
comments.body: Looks great. The fishing itself is kinda frustrating since you're basically just waiting for the fish to get stuck at the top so you can actually catch it. I think this mini game mechanic in fishing games is always unfun. Actually fishing here seems kinda random. Im just casting a line where ever and then waiting 3 seconds. It would be better if i was hunting fish on a radar or something. Id like to see my fish caught in a catalog so I can see my records.

replies.author: Known-Conversation62
replies.body: Great feedback and agree with all your points tbh ty!!
